post.description: This endpoint clones an architecture from a template.
Creates a new architecture cloned from a source architecture.
Triggers a pipeline for a given workflow and architecture.

get.description: List all architectures from a parent environment.
Lists all environments from a project.

post.description: Imports variables from terraform files into an existing architecture.

409.description: content attribute is a map containing 'variables' key with list of conflicting variable names

workflows.description: The new workflow if workflow_template was defined in the request, null otherwise

architecture.description: Should be defined with the template UUID for CloneFromTemplate

description.description: Required field with the new architecture description

environment.description: Should be defined with the environment UUID for CloneFromTemplate and CloneArchitecture

name.description: Required field with the new architecture name

project.description: Should be defined with the project UUID for CloneFromTemplate and CloneArchitecture

synced.description: Should be defined when we use CloneArchitecture

variable_values.description: Can be defined with a map of variables to override the cloned architecture variables for CloneFromTemplate and CloneArchitecture

visibility.description: Required field with the new architecture visibility

workflow_templates.description: Can be defined with the workflow template UUID for CloneFromTemplate and CloneArchitecture

anchor.description: anchor position on the node edges

id.description: reference to an existing Node ID

role.description: Used to give the User role in this project in ListProjects()
Only used and automatically populated when listing a Team within a Project to get the Team's role inside this project. See `func (p *Project) GetWithTeams(...)`

x-enum-comments.TypeBlock: used to identify parent blocks in cloudconfigs

teams.description: list of teams allowed to access the new project

override.description: set to true to override existing variables

version.description: Version is the version of the provider to use, inluding version constraint

floating.description: If true, the point is marked as floating

role.description: Only used and automatically populated when listing team's members get the User's role inside this team. See `func (t *Team) Get(...)`
